Non servono punti affinità, risposte soc: You do not need affinity points, Social Link answers or an Empress Persona with you. Come mostrare la richiesta: How to show the requested Persona
La Persona corretta deve essere nella tu: The correct Persona must be in your stock, with the exact skill visible. Having it registered is not enough: summon it. Leave and re-enter the Velvet Room so the request is recognized; after ranking up, repeat with the next one. Showing the Persona does not require sacrificing it.
Livello base e nuova fusione: Base level and a new fusion
Il livello di Yu deve raggiungere il liv: Yu’s level must reach the base level of the Persona you create. The threshold on each sheet applies to the result, not to every ingredient: a route may require higher-level ingredients. Being in NG+ alone does not let you bypass the level limit for a new fusion.
Una Persona già registrata può essere ev: A registered Persona can be summoned above Yu’s level. If all complete requests are registered, the link can reach MAX as early as May 19. The price depends on the registered version and discounts: check it in the game.
Dopo avere appreso o ereditato la skill: After learning or inheriting the required skill, update the Persona’s registration. Only then use it in the next fusion. An old Compendium entry does not receive new skills retroactively. In particular, keep Anzu, Kusi Mitama with Bufula, Jack Frost with Auto-Sukukaja and Taotie with Mind Charge.
Prima di confermare verifica nome del ri: Before confirming, check the result’s name and the skill being passed on. In Golden, you choose inherited skills manually: you do not need to repeat the original game’s random selection. If the preview does not match, cancel and check the ingredients, levels and method.
Sukukaja ≠ Auto-Sukukaja; Mahama ≠ Maham: Sukukaja ≠ Auto-Sukukaja; Mahama ≠ Mahamaon; Megido ≠ Megidola; Mediarama ≠ Mediarahan; Mind Charge ≠ Power Charge. A stronger version does not automatically satisfy the request.
Le ricette a due indicate nelle schede s: The two-Persona recipes listed on the sheets remain stable when the ingredients gain levels: the result is selected using their base levels. They can change if you choose different Personas or the wrong fusion method.
Il gioco ordina gli ingredienti in base: The game orders the ingredients by their current levels; ties use Arcana priority. The final Arcana can therefore change in NG+. The result thresholds use base levels. Update the current levels in the calculator before relying on a trio. The all-Star recipes for Ganesha avoid an Arcana change.
Golden sblocca Cross Spread (4), Pentago: Golden unlocks Cross Spread (4), Pentagon Spread (5) and Hexagon Spread (6) on July 10. Neko Shogun uses 4 ingredients; Black Frost and Yatsufusa use 5; Trumpeter uses 6. You cannot replace these with a normal pair or a trio. The July 20 date given by some guides is not used.
Puoi ottenere la Persona richiesta con q: You can obtain the requested Persona with any valid recipe, then teach it the skill with a card. All nine skills have a card. If you already have the card or its NG+ catalog entry, you do not have to inherit the skill during fusion.
Se Persona e abilità sono già registrate: If the Persona and skill are already registered together, summoning that version is enough. Summoning is not a new fusion and does not require waiting until July for a special Persona that is already registered.
Le carte Spada danno Skill Card del rela: Sword cards give Skill Cards of the corresponding rank. The sheets specify the rank and the first dungeon with a suitable range, without promising a particular card after every battle. A Magician card changes a skill: it is not the recommended deterministic method.
Una skill può essere passata attraverso: A skill can be passed through other ingredients, provided each result can inherit it. With the skill filter disabled, the calculator also shows recipes using customized ingredients. It does not assume which skills your registered version actually has.

Arahabaki 76 per Tetrakarn e Alice 77 pe: Arahabaki 76 for Tetrakarn and Alice 77 for Mind Charge are high-level donors: for Margaret, the chains using Decarabia or Taotie are usually simpler. With a prepared NG+ Compendium, however, summoning can also make the card convenient.
Dopo avere ricevuto lo scooter, compi tr: After receiving the scooter, take three local rides to unlock Okina City. Chagall Café is on the left. You do not need the café if you already have the correct Persona and skill, or the registered card.
Costo 5.000 yen e consumo del pomeriggio: Costs 5,000 yen and uses the afternoon. The first visit always gives Dia and reveals the card icons: do not expect the equipped Persona’s card immediately.
Prima di entrare equipaggia la Persona d: Before entering, equip the donor Persona; it must have learned the skill and display the card icon. Merely having it in your stock is not enough. You receive that card, paying 5,000 yen and using the afternoon.
Dopo l’estrazione l’icona scompare su qu: After extraction, the icon disappears from that version. First register a version that still has the icon in the Compendium, or register the card with Marie so you can buy it again. Registration consumes one copy: budget for buying it back before using it.
Apri il menu oggetti e usa la Skill Card: Open the item menu and use the Skill Card on the requested Persona. If it already has eight skills, choose a skill to replace. Check the exact name, register the Persona and show it to Margaret. Using the card and managing the Compendium does not use an afternoon.
Non farmare nella foresta: Do not farm in the forest
Hollow Forest non viene proposto come fo: Hollow Forest is not suggested as a source of Skill Cards. Sword card ranges refer to normal dungeons as a whole: they do not guarantee a particular card on a floor or after every victory.
Registra i donatori con la skill già pre: Register donors with the skill already present; check space in your stock and funds; save in a free working slot without overwriting A–F. Check the preview and manually select the required skill.

Controlla che il donatore abbia appreso: Check that the donor has learned and kept the skill. If it learned the skill after registration, update the Compendium. Do not confuse similar skills. Use the card as an alternative, or check the donor specified on the sheets.

Come si collega agli ending: How this relates to the endings
Empress MAX non è necessario per Normal,: Empress MAX is not required for Normal, True or Golden. It is a requirement for the optional Margaret challenge in NG+. If you want that challenge, follow the main guide’s conservative plan and finish the link before the December boss; this is not a mandatory natural deadline for the Social Link.
Ricaricare B o C elimina i ranghi e le r: Reloading B or C removes ranks and registrations obtained after that save. It does not combine progress across branches. If you max Margaret before B, all subsequent branches share the result; keep the Golden branch for last.
